description: This Java class 'ProductMapper' provides static methods for converting between 'Product' model objects and Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) like 'ProductRequest' and 'ProductResponse'. It facilitates mapping and updating entity objects based on incoming requests and creating response DTOs for output, keeping controller and service layers lean.

classes.name: ProductMapper
classes.description: A utility class providing static mapping methods between Product entity and DTOs to streamline data transformation between layers.

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts a ProductRequest DTO into a Product entity by copying relevant fields.

methods.name: updateEntity
methods.description: Updates an existing Product entity with data from a ProductRequest DTO.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Creates a ProductResponse DTO from a Product entity for output purposes.
